arguments.description: Select the absolute data/verifications/.../verification_input.json generated by a successful training run.
arguments.name: verification_config

description: Merge and verify a trained model candidate using one generated verification configuration file.
name: finetune_master_verification
template:
Complete verification-merge workflow input. When the workflow is selected, copy both lines between `<workflow_input>` and `</workflow_input>` unchanged into `run_workflow.user_prompt`.

<workflow_input>
Project root: `${CHAT_PROJECT_DIR}`
Verification config (absolute): {{verification_config}}
</workflow_input>

The selected JSON file contains all merge paths, weights, held-out prompts, subject context, acceptance criteria and report targets. Load and validate it with the dedicated tool. Never substitute values from memory, merge in place, install or update LM Studio.
